newsitem.title: INDIA: Hindustan Lever drives up Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Hindustan Lever drives up Delhi shares.

text.p: Strong investment buying in Hindustan Lever offset declines in other shares as Delhi stocks closed a shade higher in mixed trade on Monday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 1.59 points higher at 773.51.
"Sharp upsurge in heavy-weighted Hindustan Lever stocks mainly pushed up the Delhi Stock Exchange's index," said Pradeep Malhotra of brokers H.C. Sharma.
Hindustan Lever surged 24.80 rupees to 1109.80 rupees on foreign institutional buying linked to strong fundamentals, brokers said.
Traders said the prices were brought down from the day's peaks following heavy selling by Calcutta-based speculators.
"Large scale selling by Calcutta-based operators reversed the early trends," said another broker.
Reliance Industries ended 7.50 rupees lower at 293.25 on speculative selling, they said.
TISCO closed gained 3.75 rupees to 173.80 on foreign buying.
